lines.en: There's a mushroom on my head.
Each step scatters spores.
My heels land heavily.
I drag my feet toward you.
I smell of damp.
I walk with my head down.
The cap slipped. I nudge it back.
Not fast, but I'm close.
A pale layer settles behind me.
Half my clothes are soaked.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿往亮处走。
lines.en: I drag one leg toward the light.
I lurch over, step by step.
I stand; the cap stirs.
Spores drift up slowly.
I don't really need to breathe.
There's something under the cap.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看地上的孢子。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the spores.
I am cold as well water.
My fingers are stiff.
It's dim here. I like it.

lines.zh: 我扶了扶头上那朵蘑菇。
lines.en: I steady the mushroom growing on my head.
Spores coat the ground.
Don't touch my cap.
You've breathed in quite a few spores.

lines.zh: 我这张脸早就不好看了。
lines.en: This face stopped being handsome long ago.

lines.zh: 你屏着气，可孢子还在飘。
lines.en: You hold your breath, but the spores still drift.
This thing on my head keeps growing.
You carry no fungus.
The smell of iron on you is easy to spot.
Your breathing is too close.

lines.zh: 我看你，是看你还剩多少。
lines.en: I'm sizing up how much of you is left.
Leave and I'll follow.
A soft piece came off.
The mushroom on my head sways.
The spores scattered wider.

lines.zh: 我往后趔趄，鞋跟陷进泥。
lines.en: I stagger back and my heel sinks into the mud.

lines.zh: 蘑菇被我撞得歪向一边。
lines.en: The mushroom is knocked askew on my head.
I don't much feel pain now.
White threads grow in the wound.
A patch of skin came off my hand.
I steadied slowly.
That sent my cap wobbling.
Is that edible?
My mouth tastes of soil.
Lower it. I can't see.
That's growing fuzz.
I'm not a fussy eater.
There are spores on your hands.
Leave it on the soil and I will bend for it.
This is too hard for my teeth.
I prefer what comes after rain.
Don't leave your hand hanging there.
Bump me and you'll be covered in spores.
I'm soft and cold.
You stepped on my soaked shoe.
I move back slowly.
My cap brushed your shoulder.
We are wedged in the door frame.
White dust is on you.
My arm hangs beside yours.
One step back is enough.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我帽子歪了。
lines.en: That knocked my cap askew.
I don't remember much of this.
Two caps leaning together.
A cloud of spores rose.
Do not stand where the spores drift.
It's been rotting longer than me.
We're both soaked.
A layer will be left on the ground.
Afterwards we go our ways.
Nobody watched this.
Neither of us made a sound.

lines.zh: 我摸到一段发霉的木头。
lines.en: My hand finds a piece of moldy wood.
My hand doesn't quite obey.
There's a mushroom on the ground.

lines.zh: 我连土带渣一起咽下去。
lines.en: I swallow it down, dirt and all.
This is growing on my hand.

lines.zh: 指头太僵，东西掉了两回。
lines.en: My fingers are too stiff; I drop it twice.
Your thing has spores on it.

lines.zh: 我屈着僵硬的膝盖去捡。
lines.en: I bend my stiff knees to pick it up.
I press it onto my cap.
This is no use.
You came close.
The mushroom on my hat smells you first.
My cap twitched.
White flecks are starting on you.
I'm turning toward you.
This ground is mine.
Retreating won't take you far.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝你的呼吸声挪。
lines.en: I shuffle slowly toward the sound of your breathing.
Armor won't stop spores.
You're the only living thing here.
My hand is already up.
No one else at the door.

lines.zh: 我帽子上长的蘑菇，会传染。
lines.en: The mushroom on my hat spreads.
The ground you're on is damp.
Quiet. Don't shout.
The smell of rot reaches you before I do.

lines.zh: 我头上这朵蘑菇，是活的。
lines.en: The mushroom on my head is alive.
I'm following slowly.
You're behind that door.

lines.zh: 我身上的孢子飘过去了。
lines.en: My spores drifted over.
I am slow, but you cannot shake me.
You turned toward the canal.
That pale layer is mine.
Wherever you go, I go.
I hear you breathing hard.
There's no other way ahead.

lines.zh: 你背靠到潮湿的墙上了。
lines.en: Your back is to the damp wall.
My heels drag audibly.
You're in the dark. I'm used to it.
I've finished this circuit.

lines.zh: 你扶着墙走，我跟得更近。
lines.en: You walk with a hand on the wall; I close in.
My hand is reaching.
This mushroom cap fears that torch.
There's an echo by the canal.

lines.zh: 我身上一直有东西在掉。
lines.en: Things keep falling off me.
You're behind the planks.
I want to get over there too.
I sweep a hand at you.

lines.zh: 我抬手慢了半拍，还是擦到。
lines.en: My swing comes half a beat late, but it still grazes you.
A layer of spores stuck to you.
I close my hand on your cuff.
I'm stronger than I look.
The cap struck you.
You coughed a few times.
Spores got into your breath.
You backed two steps, still coughing.

lines.zh: 我这只胳膊还没使上劲。
lines.en: This arm has not put its weight in yet.

lines.zh: 我挥过来，带着一股霉味。
lines.en: I swing at you with a smell of mold.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮过你的肩甲。
lines.en: My claws scrape across your shoulder plate.
A ring of pale dust fell.

lines.zh: 我头上这顶帽，全是孢子。
lines.en: The cap on my head is all spores.
One more will do.
I stepped back half a step.

lines.zh: 我从湿透的泥土里直起腰。
lines.en: I straighten up out of the soaked earth.
The thing on my head grew first.

lines.zh: 孢子先浮起来，然后是我。
lines.en: The spores rose first, then me.
This place is damp.
I shake off the wet soil.
That white layer is mine.
I push the cap up.

lines.zh: 有东西从我身上掉下去。
lines.en: Something dropped off me.
My first breath tasted of mould.
I turned about here.
The door was open. I went in.

lines.zh: 我的衣服是从别人那拿的。
lines.en: These clothes came off someone else.
It's colder here than I expected.
I head toward the voices.
Fire scorched all the spores.
On landing, half my spores scattered.
Soaked, I rot even faster.
The blast blew the spores far.
The arrow pulled out a puff of white.
That light burned through the filaments.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是慢慢烂。
lines.en: I don't eat. I just rot slowly.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的帽子都裂了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my cap split.
There's no soil to grow in the void.
